cells.description: Static CMOS transmission-gate master-slave D flip-flop, rising edge, active-low async reset RN (hierarchical: INV, TG, NAND2, NOR2).
DICE (dual interlocked storage cell) latch: 8-transistor interlocked core plus transmission-gate write drivers; long weak keepers so writes win.
DICE master-slave D flip-flop with active-low reset; master clock delayed by two inverters (adds hold time).
Static transmission-gate D latch, transparent while EN=1.
Cross-coupled level shifter VDDL -> VDDH, split by supply domain: LS_IN (VDDL) + LS_CORE (VDDH, 5 V devices).

Power-on reset (5 V + native NMOS): threshold set by the regular-minus-native Vt difference, so it holds across process and temperature; active-low POR_N. sky130 tt/ff/ss x -55/27/125 C: releases 0.91-1.32 V, re-asserts 0.88-1.27 V (>= 77 mV inside the 0.8-1.4 V window), <= 67 uA at 5.5 V.
8-bit SIPO: 8 DFFR shift stages + 8 DLATCH output latches, 74HC595 bit order.

RHBD 8-bit SIPO datapath: 8 DICE master-slave DFFs + 8 DICE output latches + a hold-delay buffer before each stage (fixes a chained-stage hold race at 3.3/5.5 V). Verified 1.4/3.3/5.5 V; layout DRC/LVS clean.

Cold-spare-safe input buffer: PAD drives gates only + grounded-gate NMOS ESD clamp, two inverters (non-inverting). 5.5 V tolerant at any VDD; unpowered |I(PAD)| < 1 uA and no VDD back-powering. Verified 1.4/3.3/5.5 V + unpowered.

Cold-spare-safe tri-state output driver (floating n-well, gate tracking, isolated PG pass gate; OE active high). Split by body net: CS_OUT_PRE (VDD) + CS_OUT_DRV (PMOS bodies on well node NW). Verified 1.4/3.3/5.5 V + unpowered (|I(PAD)| < 1 uA at 3.3/5.5 V, no VDD back-powering).

Reset combine (ports RESET_N POR_N RN VDD VSS): RN = RESET_N AND POR_N, so the core's active-low reset is asserted by the external RESET_N pin or the internal POR. NAND2 + inverter. Verified inside the full chip top (POR ramp + functional sim at 1.4/3.3/5.5 V); no standalone testbench kind.
